description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontGULF FRONT - Amazing Views, 2 Bikes - Blue Mountain Villas 15The Space Blue Mountain Villas 15 – Gulf-Front Getaway on 30A! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Gulf-Front Condo – Wake up to breathtaking, unobstructed beach views Direct Beach Access – Private staircase leads straight to the sand 1 Bedroom + Bunks / 1 Bathroom – Sleeps up to 6 guests comfortably King Master Suite – Includes twin-over-twin bunks & shared bath with tub/shower combo Queen Sleeper Sofa – Extra sleeping space in the open-concept living area Covered Patio with Stunning Views – Perfect for coffee at sunrise or cocktails at sunset Fully Equipped Kitchen & Dining Area – Enjoy easy meals with Gulf views Wi-Fi & Streaming Only – Stay connected & enjoy your favorite shows (no cable) 2 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes – Explore 30A’s scenic trails & charming beach towns Assigned Parking + Overflow Parking – Hassle-free parking for your stay Private Beach Access Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacation Welcome to BMV 15This one-bedroom beachfront condo sits tucked away off South Walton’s Scenic 30A in its own private oasis at Blue Mountain Villas, which sits atop a sandy dune overlooking the jewel toned waters below. Blue Mountain Villas 115 provides a very romantic setting as a special beach getaway spot for your family. Views of the glistening gulf waters extend as far as the eye see can from the covered patio that is at ground level beside a lush green lawn that borders the beautiful sugar white sand beach. It is a heavenly view since the expanse of the gorgeous gulf is also highlighted by the panoramic view of the sky above where flocks of pelicans can sometimes be seen riding the wind. A staircase leads you quickly down from the lawn to the water’s edge where you may enjoy the fun as well.This spacious condo unit includes a Master bedroom with a king-sized bed, twin over twin bunk beds and a shared bathroom with tub/shower combo. The living room comes with a queen-sized sleeper sofa. The dining room and kitchen provide an open floor plan that look out on to glistening waters.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** NO CABLE. STREAMING ONLY**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (6):Master bedroom - King sized bed, twin over twin bunk; shared bathCommon area - Queen sized sleeper sofaAREA ATTRACTIONS:Welcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures.Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep.Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay! Show less
